# PHOBOS Nuclear Modification Factor in d+Au, tagged p+Au and tagged n+Au
# collisions at 200 GeV/c
#
# 2015-05-19
# 
# 
#                d2Nch(dAu)/deta.dp_t 
# R_dAu = -----------------------------------
#         <Ncoll>(dAu) d2Nch(pbarp)/deta.dp_t
# 
# 
#                d2Nch(pAu)/deta.dp_t 
# R_pAu = -----------------------------------
#         <Ncoll>(pAu) d2Nch(pbarp)/deta.dp_t
# 
# 
#                d2Nch(nAu)/deta.dp_t 
# R_nAu = -----------------------------------
#         <Ncoll>(nAu) d2Nch(pbarp)/deta.dp_t
# 
# 
# R_pnAu = (0.4 * R_pAu) + (0.6 * R_nAu)
# 
# 
# Note that systematic errors scale all points together.
#
